items.name: Bangladeshi-Classic-Games-Hub
items.description: A digital hub bringing classic Bangladeshi childhood games to life. Play Chor-Dakat-Babu-Pulish (4-player guessing), CricSpin (2-player cricket strategy with spin wheel), KaTaKuti (multi-grid tic-tac-toe), and Qub (10×10 word battle with real-time scoring) and LettR(2-player) time bounded vocabulary test.
